results.title: Forward AI Deployment Engineer (FDE)
results.long_description:
Are you energized by walking into a client’s operation, finding the workflow that’s actually holding them back, and rebuilding it so AI handles the parts that don’t need a person? At Sigma Software, we don’t just add AI on top of existing processes  we redesign how the work gets done, with AI built into the operating logic from day one.

We’re looking for a Forward AI Deployment Engineer to own that redesign end to end: embedded with the client, hands-on with whatever automation the workflow actually needs, and accountable for turning a real operational problem into something running in production not a demo, not a pilot. Each engagement is built to leave something behind for the next one patterns, infrastructure, governance that already held up in production  so the second engagement doesn’t start from zero, and the tenth looks nothing like the first.

 

Requirements

  • Proven experience taking AI systems from prototype to production inside a real operating environment, not just in a lab or sandbox
  • You treat LLM/RAG architectures, agentic systems, cloud platforms, and data pipelines as tools for redesigning how work gets done, not as the deliverable — and you’re strong and current enough with all of them to actually use them that way
  • Comfort mapping decision logic that’s partly undocumented, and judgment about where automation should stop and human accountability should start
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management — able to advise a client directly and escalate without being asked

  • BFSI domain experience is a must-have: Proven commercial experience delivering solutions for Banking, Financial Services, or Insurance, including understanding business processes, identifying operational challenges, and implementing technology solutions tailored to the domain

     

    Responsibilities

     

  • Embed directly with the client’s operational team to find the workflow that’s actually costing them time, quality, or money before recommending any tooling.
  • Own the redesign end to end: rework the decision flow and handoffs around AI, then take the resulting system into production yourself.
  • Translate a vague, cross-functional business problem into a concrete technical plan the client’s team can actually execute against.
  • Prototype fast enough to show the client what’s possible, then build only the parts of that prototype the redesigned workflow actually needs.
  • Where the redesign calls for it, build the agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or custom data pipelines that make it real never a deliverable in itself, always because the workflow needs it running in production.
  • Manage stakeholder alignment across the client’s org, escalating early and requesting support before a blocker becomes a delay.
  • Build up the client’s own team alongside the system pair with their people, explain the reasoning behind each decision, and leave them able to run and improve what you built after you’ve moved to the next engagement.
  • Build the feedback loop from day one  telemetry, evaluation pipelines, human-in-the-loop review — so the system keeps improving after you’ve moved on.

results.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go) AI Infrastructure/Agentic Systems
results.long_description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Go) — AI Infrastructure & Agentic Systems

 

Work Format: Fully Remote
Engagement: Freelance / Independent Contractor (B2B)
Workload: Full-time (40 hours/week)
Contract Duration: Initial 3 months, with the possibility of long-term extension
Compensation: Competitive, based on experience and qualifications
Start Date: ASAP

 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Backend Engineer from Ukraine to contribute to the development of an advanced AI infrastructure platform.

The project focuses on building scalable backend services that enable intelligent AI agents to interact with external systems, execute complex workflows, and perform tasks autonomously.

You will work on challenging problems at the intersection of distributed computing, cloud infrastructure, and applied artificial intelligence.

As part of an international engineering team, you will help develop reliable infrastructure supporting multiple AI-powered applications and services.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services using Go.
  • Build infrastructure supporting autonomous AI agents and multi-step task execution.
  • Implement scalable mechanisms for AI model integration, tool orchestration, and asynchronous processing.
  • Develop secure and extensible APIs and integrations with external systems.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of distributed services.
  • Design solutions for long-running workflows, isolated execution environments, and fault-tolerant processing.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
  • Participate in architectural decisions and technical design discussions.
  • Collaborate with backend, platform, product, and AI engineers.

  • Maintain engineering standards through automated testing, code reviews, and continuous delivery.

     

Required Qualifications

 

Backend Engineering

  • Strong commercial experience developing production-grade backend applications.
  • Advanced proficiency in Go (Golang).
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable, and fault-tolerant backend solutions.
     

Cloud & DevOps

  • Hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Familiarity with production monitoring, observability, and performance optimization.
     

AI & LLM Integration

  • Practical experience integrating LLMs or AI-powered functionality into production applications.
  • Understanding of AI agent architectures, model orchestration, and tool-calling mechanisms.
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) architectures.
     

Engineering Practices

  • Ability to independently evaluate technical trade-offs and make architectural decisions.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic approach to software delivery.
  • Regular use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar solutions.
     

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing autonomous AI agents and multi-step workflows.
  • Knowledge of event sourcing and event-driven architectures.
  • Python programming skills.
  • Background in AI/ML infrastructure or developer productivity platforms.
  • Experience working in startups or fast-paced technology environments.
     

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a proactive engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a practical, results-oriented approach.

You should be comfortable working with evolving architectures, exploring emerging technologies, and taking ownership of solutions from initial design to production.

The ideal candidate:

  • Makes independent technical decisions and takes responsibility for outcomes.
  • Balances rapid delivery with reliability and maintainability.
  • Thrives in dynamic environments with evolving requirements.
  • Actively explores emerging AI technologies and development practices.
  • Communicates effectively within distributed international teams.
  • Demonstrates strong ownership, autonomy, and collaborative skills.
     

What We Offer

  • Fully remote collaboration with an international engineering team.
  • Full-time freelance engagement.
  • Initial 3-month contract with the possibility of long-term cooperation.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies and agentic architectures.
  • Direct involvement in architectural decisions and technical implementation.
  • Challenging engineering problems involving distributed systems and AI infrastructure.
  • Flexible, results-oriented working environment.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

 

If you have strong Go backend development experience, solid expertise in AWS and distributed systems, and hands-on experience integrating LLMs and building AI-powered solutions, we'd be happy to hear from you!

results.title: Senior Data Engineer with Snowflake
results.long_description:
Join an exciting journey to build and scale a global Media Data Foundation for a leading global organization based in Europe. This platform brings together paid media, digital analytics and marketing performance data from dozens of advertising and measurement platforms. It unlocks reliable media reporting, marketing ROI measurement and data-driven investment decisions across markets.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing the platform's architecture. The focus is on hands-on technical execution and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Your work will turn raw media and marketing data into trusted, harmonised data products used by marketing, media and analytics teams around the world. You will use modern tools to solve complex challenges, working alongside skilled architects, engineers and business stakeholders.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Hands-On Development: Build, maintain and optimize data pipelines for ingestion, transformation and delivery of media data (Meta, Google Ads, DV360, TikTok, The Trade Desk, GA4, CM360 and others).
  • Create and implement scalable solutions to handle many data sources, frequent API and schema changes, and high volumes of data.
  • Data Modeling & Warehousing: Design and maintain efficient, harmonised data models for cross-platform media reporting in Snowflake.
  • Lead the move of transformation logic to dbt, including orchestration, testing, documentation and CI/CD.
  • Collaboration: Partner with Solution Architects to translate high-level designs into detailed implementation plans.
  • Work closely with Technical Product Owners, media agencies and market teams to align data solutions with business needs.
  • Platform Development: Enable data readiness for media dashboards (Power BI), marketing mix modelling / ROI analytics and campaign taxonomy governance.
  • Implement robust frameworks to monitor data freshness, completeness, quality and pipeline performance, with automated alerting.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement robust access controls and data protection across the pipeline and for data shared with internal and external consumers.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA) and internal data governance policies (data product tiers, tagging, naming standards).
  • Monitor and address potential vulnerabilities, including service account and secret management, ensuring the platform follows security best practices.

 

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience showing technical expertise and critical thinking in data engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt and strong Python programming skills.
  • Proficiency in Snowflake and strong expertise in data modeling are essential.
  • Demonstrated experience with marketing, media or advertising data (ad platform APIs, campaign hierarchies, web analytics) is required.
  • In-depth understanding of security and governance in Snowflake: RBAC, secure views, data sharing, masking and row access policies, object tagging.
  • Ability to design, implement and promote solution patterns and standards for complex, multi-source data platforms.
  • Familiarity with multiple cloud platforms (Azure or GCP preferred, with a focus on Azure, including ADF).
  • Experience with ETL/ELT and data integration tools (Adverity, Fivetran or similar) and batch orchestration.
  • Competence in SQL, relational database design and efficient methods for data retrieval and preparation at scale.
  • Proven ability to collect and process raw data at scale, including scripting, REST API integration and SQL querying.
  • Experience with BI tools (Power BI preferred) and supporting reporting consumers.
  • Experience working in global environments and collaborating with virtual teams and external agencies.
  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Economics or a related discipline.

results.title: System Administrator (IAM / IT Operations)
results.long_description:
Ready to build MOJAM’s IT & Security processes from scratch? Join us as a Senior IT Engineer and take over day-to-day access operations and work directly with the CISO to design a complete identity and access management process from the ground up. You will handle real employee requests while improving how access is requested, approved, provisioned, changed and removed.

We need someone who has operated these services, understands common failure modes and can turn that experience into a reliable process with less manual work. The role will also expand into managing a small device fleet, endpoint hardening and security tooling. Sounds just like you? Check out the job description below! 
 

📍What to Do:
 

  • Access Operations. Own the operational queue for access requests, changes and removals across corporate systems
  • Employee Lifecycle. Handle the technical side of onboarding, role changes and offboarding in coordination with HR, managers and application owners; keep account and entitlement records accurate
  • IAM Process Design. Work with the CISO and business stakeholders to map systems, access needs, ownership and approvals, then design and implement a consistent, highly automated end-to-end process
  • Automation & Integrations. Identify manual steps worth automating, configure IAM capabilities and connectors, and identify the integration work needed to support the process
  • Service Improvement. Investigate access and SSO issues, resolve recurring problems and maintain the practical instructions needed to operate and support the service
  • Endpoint Management. As device management is introduced, support a small fleet, maintain inventory and configure and operate MDM and EDR tooling
  • Endpoint Hardening. Help implement, validate and maintain device security configurations and support employees affected by those changes

 

🦸Your Superpowers:

 

Required Experience

At least 2 years of relevant hands-on experience in corporate IT, IAM or endpoint administration, with evidence of independently owning services and improving processes.

 

Required Hard Skills

  • Access Administration. Hands-on experience administering accounts, groups, roles and permissions in corporate applications and identity platforms
  • IAM Tools & Concepts. Experience working with IAM or identity administration tools; understanding of SSO, MFA, provisioning and employee lifecycle workflows
  • Process Design. Ability to translate access needs into workable approval, provisioning and revocation processes, including exceptions and failure handling
  • Automation Understanding. Ability to assess how connectors, APIs and workflow tools can reduce manual work, configure supported capabilities and describe integration requirements
  • Endpoint Fundamentals. Basic understanding of device administration, inventory, endpoint security and hardening principles.
  • AI-Assisted Work. Proactive use of AI tools for research, troubleshooting and day-to-day work

 

Required Soft Skills

  • Independence. Work effectively with broad goals, investigate unfamiliar problems and keep work moving without constant supervision
  • Ownership. Follow requests and dependencies through to closure; raise blockers early with a proposed next step
  • Stakeholder Collaboration. Clarify requirements and agree practical solutions with employees, managers, HR and technical teams
  • Planning & Execution. Balance daily service requests with implementation work and communicate progress and trade-offs clearly

 

🤘Bonus Points:

 

  • Experience building or migrating IAM and Joiner/Mover/Leaver processes
  • Hands-on implementation of automated provisioning, SSO integrations or access workflows
  • Scripting or programming skills and experience developing custom integrations
  • Hands-on experience with macOS administration, endpoint hardening, and deploying or managing MDM/EDR solutions

 

🍪Team Perks:

 

  • PRO&BRO team you’ll love creating new gaming universes with 
  • Totally remote work from wherever you grind
  • An equipment budget to upgrade your home office
  • Flexible schedule with no time trackers since we just focus on results
  • A performance-based bonus twice a year for every mojamer as a nod to our shared achievements 
  • Wellness Bonus for the gym, yoga, dance, massage, therapy, or anything that keeps your energy up
  • Level up your skills with our internal knowledge-sharing project Yoda. We also cover training, certifications, English & Ukrainian classes
  • Days off and gifts for milestones of your choice (birthday, anniversary, baby arrival, or wedding) 
  • JAM Activities: workations twice a year in different corners of the world, epic offline teambuilding events, CS2 and Dota tournaments, quizzes, lectures, and plenty of other hangouts for the team
  • Plus relocation support, a Maternity/Paternity Leave Policy, a referral bonus, and a whole bunch of other cool perks you can check out on our website

 

Join us if this is all about you. We are waiting for your CV!

Let’s Add More Jam Together

results.long_description:
Ready to build MOJAM’s IT & Security processes from scratch? Join us as a Senior IT Engineer and take over day-to-day access operations and work directly with the CISO to design a complete identity and access management process from the ground up. You will handle real employee requests while improving how access is requested, approved, provisioned, changed and removed.

We need someone who has operated these services, understands common failure modes and can turn that experience into a reliable process with less manual work. The role will also expand into managing a small device fleet, endpoint hardening and security tooling. Sounds just like you? Check out the job description below! 
 

📍What to Do:
 

  • Access Operations. Own the operational queue for access requests, changes and removals across corporate systems
  • Employee Lifecycle. Handle the technical side of onboarding, role changes and offboarding in coordination with HR, managers and application owners; keep account and entitlement records accurate
  • IAM Process Design. Work with the CISO and business stakeholders to map systems, access needs, ownership and approvals, then design and implement a consistent, highly automated end-to-end process
  • Automation & Integrations. Identify manual steps worth automating, configure IAM capabilities and connectors, and identify the integration work needed to support the process
  • Service Improvement. Investigate access and SSO issues, resolve recurring problems and maintain the practical instructions needed to operate and support the service
  • Endpoint Management. As device management is introduced, support a small fleet, maintain inventory and configure and operate MDM and EDR tooling
  • Endpoint Hardening. Help implement, validate and maintain device security configurations and support employees affected by those changes

 

🦸Your Superpowers:

 

Required Experience

At least 2 years of relevant hands-on experience in corporate IT, IAM or endpoint administration, with evidence of independently owning services and improving processes.

 

Required Hard Skills

  • Access Administration. Hands-on experience administering accounts, groups, roles and permissions in corporate applications and identity platforms
  • IAM Tools & Concepts. Experience working with IAM or identity administration tools; understanding of SSO, MFA, provisioning and employee lifecycle workflows
  • Process Design. Ability to translate access needs into workable approval, provisioning and revocation processes, including exceptions and failure handling
  • Automation Understanding. Ability to assess how connectors, APIs and workflow tools can reduce manual work, configure supported capabilities and describe integration requirements
  • Endpoint Fundamentals. Basic understanding of device administration, inventory, endpoint security and hardening principles.
  • AI-Assisted Work. Proactive use of AI tools for research, troubleshooting and day-to-day work

 

Required Soft Skills

  • Independence. Work effectively with broad goals, investigate unfamiliar problems and keep work moving without constant supervision
  • Ownership. Follow requests and dependencies through to closure; raise blockers early with a proposed next step
  • Stakeholder Collaboration. Clarify requirements and agree practical solutions with employees, managers, HR and technical teams
  • Planning & Execution. Balance daily service requests with implementation work and communicate progress and trade-offs clearly

 

🤘Bonus Points:

 

  • Experience building or migrating IAM and Joiner/Mover/Leaver processes
  • Hands-on implementation of automated provisioning, SSO integrations or access workflows
  • Scripting or programming skills and experience developing custom integrations
  • Hands-on experience with macOS administration, endpoint hardening, and deploying or managing MDM/EDR solutions

 

🍪Team Perks:

 

  • PRO&BRO team you’ll love creating new gaming universes with 
  • Totally remote work from wherever you grind
  • An equipment budget to upgrade your home office
  • Flexible schedule with no time trackers since we just focus on results
  • A performance-based bonus twice a year for every mojamer as a nod to our shared achievements 
  • Wellness Bonus for the gym, yoga, dance, massage, therapy, or anything that keeps your energy up
  • Level up your skills with our internal knowledge-sharing project Yoda. We also cover training, certifications, English & Ukrainian classes
  • Days off and gifts for milestones of your choice (birthday, anniversary, baby arrival, or wedding) 
  • JAM Activities: workations twice a year in different corners of the world, epic offline teambuilding events, CS2 and Dota tournaments, quizzes, lectures, and plenty of other hangouts for the team
  • Plus relocation support, a Maternity/Paternity Leave Policy, a referral bonus, and a whole bunch of other cool perks you can check out on our website

 

Join us if this is all about you. We are waiting for your CV!

Let’s Add More Jam Together

Шукаємо розробника для створення та вдосконалення алгоритмів планування маршрутів і навігації з урахуванням геопросторових даних, особливостей місцевості та обмежень літального апарата.

 

Основні обов'язки:

  • Розробка та оптимізація алгоритмів планування маршрутів.
  • Реалізація алгоритмів пошуку шляху (A*, Theta*, RRT та аналоги).
  • Робота з геопросторовими даними, картами та цифровими моделями рельєфу.
  • Врахування особливостей місцевості та технічних обмежень літального апарата під час побудови маршрутів.
  • Тестування, аналіз та оптимізація ефективності алгоритмів.

 

Наші вимоги:

  • Досвід розробки від 2 років на C++ або Python (бажано обома мовами).
  • Сильний математичний бекграунд: алгоритми, оптимізація, теорія графів.
  • Практичний досвід реалізації алгоритмів планування шляху (A*, Theta*, RRT або аналоги).
  • Розуміння геопросторових даних: системи координат, проекції, GeoJSON, DEM та растрові моделі рельєфу.
  • Навички алгоритмічного мислення та вирішення складних технічних задач.

 

Буде перевагою:

  • Практичний досвід навчання нейронних мереж (PyTorch або TensorFlow).
  • Розуміння динаміки та обмежень літальних апаратів: радіус розвороту, енергоспоживання, вплив вітру, набір висоти.
  • Досвід у робототехніці, GIS, авіаційних симуляторах або GameDev (розробка стратегій, симуляторів та систем Pathfinding).
  • Досвід роботи з алгоритмами навігації та автономного планування руху.

 

Що пропонуємо ми:

  • Офіційне працевлаштування на основі Дія Сіті.
  • Бронювання і підтримка на кожному етапі оформлення.
  • Офісний формат (правий берег), ПН-ПТ.
  • Участь у розробці масштабного оборонного проєкту.
  • Власний спортзал, йога студія, масажний кабінет і кав’ярні.
  • Конкурентна заробітна плата із регулярним переглядом.
  • Чіткі та прозорі можливості для професійного розвитку.

 

Долучайтесь до команди Stellar Jet та зробіть свій внесок у розвиток технологій.

results.title: Product Analyst
results.long_description:
Шукаємо Product Analyst із досвідом від 3 років, який допоможе нам глибше розуміти поведінку користувачів, знаходити точки зростання продукту та покращувати ключові бізнес-метрики.

Нам потрібен не просто аналітик, який будує дашборди та пише SQL-запити, а людина, яка вміє знаходити причинно-наслідкові зв’язки, перетворювати дані на продуктові рішення та оцінювати їхній реальний вплив на бізнес.

Основні напрями роботи - Retention та Payments.
 

Що потрібно буде робити

1. Retention & User Behavior

  • Аналізувати шлях користувача від реєстрації та онбордингу до активації й переходу в сегмент платоспроможних користувачів (китів).
  • Знаходити вузькі місця в користувацькому досвіді та моменти, які впливають на активацію й утримання.
  • Виявляти ранні сигнали відтоку та розробляти підходи до проактивного утримання користувачів.
  • Сегментувати аудиторію за цінністю, поведінкою та ризиком відтоку.
  • Аналізувати ефективність win-back механік: email-комунікацій, бонусів, персональних пропозицій та інших інструментів повернення.
  • Проводити когортний аналіз, досліджувати LTV, поведінку high-value users та переходи між користувацькими сегментами.


2. Payments & Fraud

  • Аналізувати платіжну конверсію в розрізі провайдерів, методів оплати, географії та банків-емітентів.
  • Досліджувати причини відмов платежів і знаходити можливості для підвищення payment success rate.
  • Аналізувати ефективність платіжних каскадів та оптимізувати маршрутизацію між платіжними провайдерами.
  • Досліджувати фродові патерни, chargebacks та refunds.
  • Допомагати знаходити баланс між зменшенням фродових втрат і мінімізацією false positive - блокування легітимних користувачів.
     

3. Product Analytics

  • Проєктувати та аналізувати A/B-тести, оцінювати статистичну значущість і бізнес-ефект змін.
  • Відокремлювати вплив продуктових змін від сезонності, змін у закупівлі трафіку та інших зовнішніх факторів.
  • Формувати й перевіряти продуктові гіпотези.
  • Брати участь у постановці задач для розробки, формулювати рекомендації на основі даних.
  • Контролювати ключові метрики після релізів та оцінювати фактичний результат.
  • Підтримувати й розвивати наявні BI-дашборди та звітність.


Що для нас важливо

  • Від 3 років досвіду саме в продуктовій аналітиці.
  • Впевнений SQL: вмієш самостійно досліджувати дані, писати складні запити та перевіряти результати. AI-інструменти використовуєш для прискорення роботи, але розумієш, що саме робить твій запит і чи коректний його результат.
  • Розуміння принципів побудови BI-звітності. У нас уже є налаштована інфраструктура, тому основне завдання - підтримувати, покращувати та розвивати наявні рішення.
  • Практичне розуміння A/B-тестування та експериментального дизайну.
  • Розуміння продуктових метрик, KPI, retention, LTV, conversion rate та інших показників ефективності продукту.
  • Уміння знаходити причинно-наслідкові зв’язки та відрізняти реальний ефект від кореляції.
  • Навички комунікації: вмієш аргументувати свою позицію, презентувати результати та зрозуміло доносити висновки до продуктової команди.
  • Вміння розділяти факти, припущення та гіпотези.
     

Буде великим плюсом

  • Досвід роботи з Claude, Codex та іншими AI-інструментами для досліджень, аналізу даних і автоматизації рутини.
  • Досвід у бізнесах із whale-моделлю (висока частка доходу від невеликої кількості high-value users).
  • Досвід роботи з транзакційними продуктами, а не лише підписковими моделями.
  • Практичний досвід роботи з платіжними провайдерами, payment routing, каскадами та антифрод-системами.
  • Досвід роботи з Python.
     

Технологічний стек

  • Google BigQuery
  • SQL
  • Apache Airflow
  • Apache Superset
  • Python
  • Claude Code, Codex
     

AI-first — це частина нашої робочої культури.

Ми активно використовуємо AI для написання та рев’ю SQL-запитів, дослідження даних, автоматизації аналітичних процесів, підготовки висновків і постановки технічних завдань.

Ми оплачуємо інструменти, підтримуємо навчання та заохочуємо експерименти з новими технологіями. Очікуємо, що ти будеш інтегрувати AI у свою щоденну роботу. Якщо поки не маєш достатнього досвіду - допоможемо розібратися.

Аналітик працює безпосередньо з даними в BigQuery, без довгої черги через дата-інженерів.
 

Що пропонуємо

  • Можливість у перспективі очолити напрям продуктово-аналітичної роботи.
  • Команду досвідчених спеціалістів із 10+ роками досвіду у своїх напрямах.
  • Багаті поведінкові та платіжні дані для досліджень.
  • Різнопланові продуктові задачі з прямим впливом на бізнес-результати.
  • Короткий шлях від аналітичного інсайту до продуктового рішення - без зайвої бюрократії.
  • Підтримку, навчання та доступ до сучасних AI-інструментів.
     

Якщо тобі цікаво не просто аналізувати цифри, а знаходити можливості для зростання продукту, впливати на рішення та бачити фінансовий результат своєї роботи - будемо раді познайомитися!
